title: Outreach record
description: Per-company outreach package, keyed by company id (outreach/<id>.json). Drafted by the prospect-outreach agent (email + a copy-paste text + researched contacts to validate), then edited / validated / sent by a human in the dashboard. Email is the only channel the app sends (via SMTP); text is copy-paste only.

text.description: A short channel-agnostic message the operator COPIES into WhatsApp/IG/SMS. Never auto-sent.

contacts.description: Contacts the agent researched, for the operator to validate before use. NEVER fabricated — empty if none found.

source.description: Where it was found (URL / 'website contact page' / 'discovery').

confidence.description: 0..1 — how sure the agent is this reaches a decision-maker.

chosenRecipient.description: The email address the operator picked to send to (a contact value or correctedValue).

pitchAngle.description: Carried from the hunt assessment: redesign | get-a-site | ai-upsell | marketing-growth | compound.

status.description: draft (agent wrote it) → validated (operator checked it) → bundled (queued in a send bundle) → sending → sent | failed.

textMarkedAt.description: When the operator marked the text message as sent (manually, elsewhere).

messageId.description: SMTP message id of the sent email.

history.description: Append-only audit trail of status transitions / sends.
